name: Froxel Volumetric Fog with Path-Traced Shadows
definition: A volumetric fog rendering technique using a frustum-aligned 3D grid of voxels (froxels) where lighting is computed via path tracing (specifically Next Event Estimation shadow rays) rather than shadow maps, allowing real color transmission through tinted dielectrics.
summary: Froxel Volumetric Fog with Path-Traced Shadows renders fog in a frustum-aligned grid using path-traced shadow rays to enable real color transmission through tinted materials.
